newsitem.title: KENYA: Tea prices mixed at Kenya auction.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices mixed at Kenya auction.

text.p: Kenya tea prices were mixed on Monday at the weekly Kenyan auction amid good general demand, auction officials said.

Brighter and medium BPl's increased by two to five cents while lower mediums were fully firm to two cents dearer. Brighter PFls were irregular, but on balance firm with lighter descriptions about steady. Brighter PDUSTs held firm while mediums were irregular but often easier.
Most Fannings and cleaner Dusts held steady, more fibrous types held steady.
There was strong enquiry from Egypt and the Sudan.
